steps.title: Welcome to Northbridge
steps.text: Welcome to Northbridge, where messages land on your screen all day and most of them are harmless. A few are traps dressed up to look urgent, friendly, or official, and you get only seconds to decide. Shield, your sidekick, explains every one so you learn the tricks. Now it's head to head: who can tell a phish from fine the fastest?

steps.title: What is Phish or Fine?
steps.text: Phish or Fine is a buzzer quiz for 2 to 6 players. Two players face off at a time, racing to judge each message on the screen. With more players, it becomes a bracket where winners move on. Every point counts on one leaderboard, and a full battle takes about three minutes.

steps.title: Two buzzers, one race
steps.text: Two players face off. One side buzzes with A and S, the other with K and L, or just tap your buttons.

steps.title: Phish or fine?
steps.text: Read the message. Buzz Phish if it's a scam, or Fine if it's safe.

steps.title: Fast and right
steps.text: You get six seconds. First right answer scores a hundred. A wrong buzz costs fifty and hands your rival a shot.

steps.title: Streaks and lessons
steps.text: Three in a row earns a bonus, and Shield explains every answer so you learn the red flags. Let's battle!
